candidates.title: Daily sales by product (till system, Retail Operations)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of daily units_sold and revenue_eur per product_code; catalog says daily grain, refreshed daily (last 2026-10-14), coverage from 2022-01-01 with no end date. Covers both windows on paper.
candidates.found_via: search_internal_catalog 'Valdena daily sales by product' and 'product code change 2024 mapping'
suspected_issues: Till system replaced 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10; no rows for those days (wiki till_migration_2024, last edited 2024-03-12). Must be treated as missing, not zero.
Product codes changed 2024-04-01 (wiki product_codes_2024); codes ending in 'L' replaced; no mapping table exists, so history and recent do not join on product_code without N2 work.
Wiki pages last edited 2024; no evidence they were updated after 2024 - currency of the gap description unverified.
Catalog does not state whether revenue is net of refunds/voids/discounts or whether units are net; cut-off timezone not documented.
Classification confidential; access via warehouse SQL on request to Retail Operations (access granted status unknown).

candidates.title: Product list (current codes, names, categories)
candidates.why_relevant: Only product-name reference in the warehouse. Useful as the name side for a manual name-based match across the 2024 code change, but it lists current codes only, so it cannot serve as the mapping itself.
suspected_issues: Lists only current codes (wiki product_codes_2024); retired pre-2024 codes absent.
Wiki says matching by name is ambiguous because some names are not unique.
No version or date on product names.

candidates.title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source for is_open and event_name by calendar_date. Needed to separate closed days (absent or zero sales) from trading days and to flag any local events. Covers 2022 onward per catalog.
suspected_issues: Refreshed weekly; no wiki page documents it and there are no wiki backlinks, so its provenance and how is_open was populated (log vs roster) is unknown.
event_name is free text; coverage of events is unknown.
Row count ~1500 vs ~1,400 days 2022-2026 suggests possible incomplete coverage - to verify by profiling, not assumed.
Owner/steward Elena Russo / Store Operations; request process 'open to analytics roles'.

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
candidates.why_relevant: Register source for daily temperature_2m_max by latitude/longitude; agreement not required (open data), approved for prototyping and production. Covers the requested date ranges per register note to be confirmed.
suspected_issues: Register default_query coordinates (45.46, 9.19) and timezone UTC are defaults, not the shop location; the shop city is not named in any internal source, so the location must be chosen and recorded in decisions.md as an assumption. Europe/Rome timezone must be set explicitly.
Reanalysis is modelled data, not station observations.
Register default query is hourly; daily variable and date range must be set in the call.

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API (country IT, per year)
candidates.why_relevant: Register source for national public holidays by year and country code. Needed for the holiday flag covering 2023 to 2026 (one call per year, IT).
suspected_issues: Nager returns national holidays only; regional and patron-saint days are not covered and must be flagged as gaps or sourced separately.
Holiday flag is not the same as the shop being closed; closure must come from internal calendar.
Easter-linked dates must be checked against an official Italian source for a sample (not yet done).
